source.description: arq_uuid accepted from caller (KB entry-point) and interpolated into Cyborg API URL path in get_arq_by_uuid

sink.description: HTTP GET /accelerator_requests/{arq_uuid}: arq_uuid concatenated into URL path via "/".join([self.ARQ_URL, arq_uuid]) without UUID-format or path-character validation

stoppedAt.detail: get_arq_by_uuid (defined at cyborg.py:337) has NO production call site in the 1509-file near-complete source set (only 10 unresolved imports remain, all in test files). grep for both 'get_arq_by_uuid' and '.get_arq_by_uuid' over all production files returns only the definition at cyborg.py:337. Five production files call cyborg.get_client() and store the result in a local variable (compute/api.py:4578, compute/manager.py:3024, compute/utils.py:1622, conductor/manager.py:938, network/neutron.py:673) then call other methods on the client, but not get_arq_by_uuid. The method is tested directly in tests/unit/accelerator/test_cyborg.py and mocked by CyborgFixture but mock_get_arq_by_uuid is never asserted in any test. The method may be dead code in the current codebase version, or called only via a local-variable dispatch pattern invisible to both static analysis and grep. Per protocol, the chain remains partial rather than terminated because the local-variable blind spot cannot be ruled out.

sanitisationGaps: No UUID format check or path-character filtering visible between method parameter (line 337) and HTTP call (lines 358-359) in get_arq_by_uuid.
